CHAPTER Ill
MANAGEMENT OF MANDATORY LEGAL ASSIGNMENT
r
SECTION 11: · Mandatory lpegal assignment shall be managed by the
government authority or where applicable, a public reinsurance body.
.
SECTION 12: (1) ln its capacity as assignee, the government authority in
w
charge of legal assignment must insure the risks relating to the mandatory
legal assignment until payment of the assignment amounts, less net
retentions of each assignor.
w
(2) lt shall also pay commissions to companies subject to
the legal assignment at a rate fixed for each branch and category.
w
SECTION 13: The government authority in charge of legal assignment
shall grant assigner companies the same entitlements and benefits as
other reinsurers.
SECTION 14: (1) lnsurance companies shall be bound to fill and forward
within 15 (fifteen) days, to the government authority in charge of legal
assignment, risks declaration forms for every insurance contract signed.
(2) They must also declare risk level changes as well as
contracts terminated or cancelled.

SECTION 19: The government authority in charge of legal assignment
shall guarantee its commitment to mitigate the risks emanating from the
mandatory legal assignment by providing assignors with premium and
claim deposits.
SECTION 20: Premiums or deposits shall be deposited in cash at the end
of the fourth quarter of the financial year. They shall correspond to at least
36% (thirty-six percent) of the premium or contribution base available for
m
that year ând not cancelled at the time of the inventory.
SECTION 21: Deposits of 100% (one hundred percent) losses shail
equally be constituted in cash and must featucre in the accounts of the
fourth quarter of the financial year.
.
SECTION 22: The deposits referred to in Sections 20 and 21 above shall
c
be re!eased in the corresponding accounts of the next financial year with
interest equal to that of conventional treaties.
r
SECTION 23: (1) Assignorps shall provide the government authority in
charge of legal assignment, and at its behest, any information pertaining
to mandatory legal assignment transactions.
.
w
(2) The government authority in charge of legal assignment
may have the assignor's books, ledgers and documents relating to
mandatory legal assignment transactions verified at any given time.
w
CHAPTER IV
MISCELLANEOUS, TRANSITIONAL AND FINAL PROVISIONS
w
SECTION 24: The conditions for implementing this law shall be laid down,
as and when necessary, by regulation.
SECTION 25: lnsurance bodies concerned by the provisions of this law
shall have one year from the date of its enactment to comply therewith.
SECTION 26: Pending the establishment of a public reinsurance body, the
minister in charge of insurance shall set up a mechanism for the effective
management of legal assignment as provided for in this law.
SECTION 27: Ali previous provisions repugnant hereto are repealed and
shaii so remain.

SECTION 28: This law shall be registered, published according to the
procedure of urgency and inserted in the Official Gazette in English and
French.
